big: Gold was broadly flat to weak in rupees from 2013 to 2018. A client who bought in 2013 waited years with little to show. Then it rallied from 2019 and strongly in 2024 to 2026.

lines: It is a hedge, not the core. Long flat periods test patience. Gold cushions falls, but equity remains the long-term wealth creator. So we hold gold in measured amounts and do not chase it after a rally.
